name: Esso S.A.F.
summary: Esso S.A.F. refines, distributes, and markets refined petroleum products in France and internationally. The company offers gas and diesel, aviation, and marine fuels and lubricants. It provides its products under the Esso brand and lubricants under the Mobil brand. The company also operates a network of service stations under the Esso and Esso Express brands, as well as provides greases. It markets its products through a network of authorized distributors, resellers, and directly to industrial accounts. The company was founded in 1902 and is headquartered in Courbevoie, France.
